title: Verify: gridToRgba unit tests
summary: Unit tests for gridToRgba dimensions, palette-only colours and out-of-range rejection
description: Write TDD-style unit tests from REQ-G importing gridToRgba and PALETTE directly; no mocks needed as the function is pure.
acceptance_criteria: Tests assert width, height and data length
Tests assert every pixel colour is in the shared palette
Tests assert out-of-range, negative, non-integer indices and ragged grids throw
Tests assert identical bytes on repeated calls
technical_constraints: Unit tests only; no browser or server
definition_of_done: Test file passes with the command given

steps.action: Add tests importing gridToRgba from '../src/lib/gridToRgba' and PALETTE from '../src/lib/palette'. Test 'returns size': grid [[0,1,2],[3,4,5]] gives width 3, height 2, data.length 24. Test 'palette-only colours': build a Set of '#rrggbb' strings from PALETTE, convert every pixel of a grid using indices 0..47 back to hex and assert membership and alpha 255.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/gridToRgba.test.ts

steps.action: Add tests: expect(() => gridToRgba([[PALETTE.length]])).toThrow(); same for [[-1]] and [[1.5]]; ragged [[0,1],[0]] throws; [] throws; two calls on the same grid give equal arrays via expect(Array.from(a.data)).toEqual(Array.from(b.data)).
